chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Asheym, from Suleyman al-Ja'fari, who said:
Whoever wants to gain flesh (weight), let him enter the bathhouse one day and be absent from it one day; and whoever wants to slim down and is of much flesh, let him enter the bathhouse every day.
ai.seo_question: How should one use the bathhouse to gain or lose weight according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi*’s chapter on the bathhouse, this hadith illustrates the early Islamic emphasis on *al-tibb al-nabawi* (Prophetic medicine) by linking hygiene routines to constitutional health management. It reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of viewing the bathhouse not merely as a place of cleanliness but as a therapeutic tool for regulating bodily humors and physical strength. This practical guidance underscores the holistic approach to well-being where ritual purity and physical health are mutually reinforcing.
